candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All text is correct. Furigana appears only on the five words that carry it in the image (特売日, 豆, 給料, 卵焼, 健康). Heading markup suits the bold title; blanks are preserved. B lines are not indented, which is minor.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are fully accurate with nothing added. B lines are indented to match the layout. The title is left as plain text with no heading markup.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Text and furigana are accurate; 'たまご や' has a space, which mirrors the image spacing. Heading markup is used. The A/B lines have no blank line between them, so they would merge into one paragraph when rendered.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Adds furigana 安(やす) and 買(か) that are not in the image. Everything else is accurate. No heading markup.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Invents furigana on many words that have none in the image: 文, 完成, 今日, 安, 買, 言, 毎日, 料理, 作. The base text itself is correct, and B lines are indented.

rationale: A, B and C all transcribe the text accurately with furigana only where the image has it; they differ only in small formatting points: A has heading markup and clean paragraphs, B lacks the heading but indents the B lines, and C's A/B lines would merge when rendered. D invents two furigana readings, and E invents furigana throughout, so they rank fourth and last.
